item.title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
item.description:
Audio adaptation of Anthropic’s Scion post: why git broke at 30k merges/day, how a changeset-based VCS and three-tier cache replaced mirrors, and why they still don’t want you to fork git.
Source: https://www.anthropic.com/research/redesigning-source-control
